notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch (curl, desktop UA), no proxy/Playwright needed - confirms prior Furniture-pass note that Bassett (Salesforce Commerce Cloud) is reachable directly. robots.txt checked first: only disallows /search-jobs/, /account/, /customer-service-contact-us, /viewer, /tools.html; no Claude-specific disallow. Discovery: main nav (home.html), sitemap_0.xml (15963 lines, grepped for best|top-sell|popular|trending|favorite), and direct URL probing of department-scoped variants. Found genuine site taxonomy 'Best Sellers': top-level https://www.bassettfurniture.com/best-sellers (H1 'Best Sellers', title 'Best Selling Furniture all Made in the USA') plus three department-scoped listings that share the same breadcrumb pattern (Home > <Department>) and page template: /bedroom/best-sellers, /dining/best-sellers, /living/best-sellers. Probed for sibling department pages /office/best-sellers, /home-office/best-sellers, /outdoor/best-sellers, /mattresses/best-sellers, /home-decor/best-sellers - all 404, confirming only these 4 Bestsellers PLPs exist. All qty values are the SFCC 'N Results' header text; spot-verified the top-level page exhaustively via ?start=0&sz=300 - counted 260 unique data-pid attributes, exactly matching the '260 Results' header (same method used successfully in prior Home-Decor pass). Department pages (44+44+130=218) do not sum to the site-wide 260, confirming the top-level page is a broader/independent listing (covers other departments too, e.g. outdoor/home office bestsellers are folded into it with no dedicated department page), not a pure union of the three department pages, so all 4 are kept as separate rows (top-level flagged is_group:true as the umbrella grouping, department ones as leaves). EXCLUDED as NOT Bestsellers: 'Valued Favorites' pages (/bedroom/bedroom-collections/valued-favorites, /living/sofa-and-sectional-collections/valued-favorites, /sale/valued-favorites) - opened and read meta/title: 'Valued Favorites Home Furniture - Quality Style, Irresistible Prices', breadcrumb Home > Sale; this is a value/affordability-priced product line, not a popularity/bestseller merchandising concept, so it fails brief section 3 test #2 despite the word 'favorites'. Also excluded generic /sale hub and its Black Friday/Labor Day/Fourth of July/Special Buys/Ready to Ship promo sub-pages as out of scope for this file (irrelevant to Bestsellers). No ambiguous cases for Bestsellers specifically, so no flags needed.
